props.name: peek
props.description: How far the corner lifts on hover, in pixels.

props.name: threshold
props.description: How far it can be dragged before it comes off.

props.name: onPeel
props.description: Fires once it is fully peeled off.

props.name: peeled
props.description: Put it back. Controlled — omit for uncontrolled.

props.name: radius
props.description: Any CSS length. Match the surface it sits on.
